RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

The panel's composition is not evidence. All-women panels occur routinely by chance and by committee rotation, and there's no reliable finding that women panels favour women candidates — some studies find the opposite. Leading with it will read as grievance and will cost you credibility on your stronger ground.

Your stronger ground is procedural and substantive: a completed PhD, three times the publications, and four years of teaching, versus an unfinished PhD. That's a documented gap that demands reasons.

So: send a firm written follow-up citing your right to a reasoned decision, with a deadline. If "industry experience" wasn't a weighted criterion in the advertisement, that's your real question — ask for the scoring matrix.
